issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC), Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Culture and Tourism, State Administration for Market Regulation, and National Radio and Television Administration
covered_actors: Internet information service enterprises using algorithms
Provincial, autonomous region, municipal, and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps regulatory departments
prohibited_practices: Using algorithms to interfere with public opinion
Using algorithms to infringe upon netizens' legitimate rights and interests

evidence.quote: （八）积极开展算法安全评估。组织建立专业技术评估队伍，深入分析算法机制机理，评估算法设计、部署和使用等应用环节的缺陷和漏洞，研判算法应用产生的意识形态、社会公平、道德伦理等安全风险，提出针对性应对措施。
evidence.source_section: 三、构建算法安全监管体系
evidence.quote_en: (8) Actively carry out algorithm security assessments. Organize and establish professional technical assessment teams to deeply analyze algorithm mechanisms, assess defects and vulnerabilities in algorithm design, deployment, and use, evaluate security risks such as ideology, social fairness, and ethics arising from algorithm applications, and propose targeted countermeasures.

evidence.quote: 企业应建立算法安全责任制度和科技伦理审查制度，健全算法安全管理组织机构，加强风险防控和隐患排查治理，提升应对算法安全突发事件的能力和水平。
evidence.source_section: 二、健全算法安全治理机制
evidence.quote_en: Enterprises should establish an algorithm security responsibility system and a science and technology ethics review system, improve algorithm security management organizations, strengthen risk prevention and control and hazard screening and remediation, and enhance the capacity and level of responding to algorithm security emergencies.

evidence.quote: （九）有序推进算法备案工作。建立算法备案制度，梳理算法备案基本情况，健全算法分级分类体系，明确算法备案范围，有序开展备案工作。积极做好备案指导帮助，主动公布备案情况，接受社会监督。
evidence.source_section: 三、构建算法安全监管体系
evidence.quote_en: (9) Orderly advance algorithm filing work. Establish an algorithm filing system, sort out the basic situation of algorithm filing, improve the algorithm grading and classification system, clarify the scope of algorithm filing, and carry out filing work in an orderly manner. Actively provide filing guidance and assistance, proactively publish filing status, and accept public supervision.

evidence.quote: 督促企业及时、合理、有效地公开算法基本原理、优化目标、决策标准等信息，做好算法结果解释，畅通投诉通道，消除社会疑虑，推动算法健康发展。
evidence.source_section: 四、促进算法生态规范发展
evidence.quote_en: Urge enterprises to timely, reasonably, and effectively disclose basic algorithm principles, optimization objectives, decision-making standards, and other information, properly explain algorithm results, keep complaint channels unobstructed, dispel public doubts, and promote the healthy development of algorithms.

evidence.quote: （三）强化统筹协同治理。网信部门会同宣传、教育、科技、工信、公安、文化和旅游、市场监管、广电等部门，建立部门协同联动长效机制，履行监管职责，共同开展算法安全治理工作。
evidence.source_section: 二、健全算法安全治理机制
evidence.quote_en: (3) Strengthen coordinated and collaborative governance. Cyberspace administration departments, together with publicity, education, science and technology, industry and information technology, public security, culture and tourism, market regulation, and radio and television departments, shall establish a long-term inter-departmental coordination mechanism, fulfill supervisory duties, and jointly carry out algorithm security governance.

evidence.quote: （十一）严厉打击违法违规行为。着力解决网民反映强烈的算法安全问题，对算法监测、评估、备案等工作中发现的、以及网民举报并查实的涉算法违法违规行为，予以严厉打击，坚决维护互联网信息服务算法安全。
evidence.source_section: 三、构建算法安全监管体系
evidence.quote_en: (11) Strictly crack down on illegal and non-compliant acts. Focus on resolving algorithm security issues strongly reported by netizens, and strictly crack down on algorithm-related illegal and non-compliant acts discovered during algorithm monitoring, assessment, and filing, as well as those reported by netizens and verified, to resolutely safeguard internet information service algorithm security.

evidence.quote: （九）有序推进算法备案工作。建立算法备案制度，梳理算法备案基本情况，健全算法分级分类体系，明确算法备案范围，有序开展备案工作。积极做好备案指导帮助，主动公布备案情况，接受社会监督。
evidence.source_section: 三、构建算法安全监管体系
evidence.quote_en: (9) Orderly advance algorithm filing work. Establish an algorithm filing system, sort out the basic situation of algorithm filing, improve the algorithm grading and classification system, clarify the scope of algorithm filing, and carry out filing work in an orderly manner. Actively provide filing guidance and assistance, proactively publish filing status, and accept public supervision.

evidence.quote: （五）强化行业组织自律。互联网信息服务行业应当加强行业自律，积极开展算法科学技术普及工作，逐步组建算法安全治理力量，吸引专业人才队伍，汇聚多方资源投入，承担算法安全治理社会责任，为算法安全治理提供有力支撑。
evidence.source_section: 二、健全算法安全治理机制
evidence.quote_en: (5) Strengthen industry organization self-discipline. The internet information service industry should strengthen industry self-discipline, actively carry out popularization of algorithm science and technology, gradually build algorithm security governance capacity, attract professional talent, pool multi-party resources, assume social responsibility for algorithm security governance, and provide strong support for algorithm security governance.

enforcement_authorities: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
Local counterpart departments at the provincial, autonomous region, municipal, and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps levels
compliance_deadlines: Approximately three years (around 2024) to gradually establish a comprehensive algorithm security governance framework, regulatory system, and standardized algorithm ecosystem
penalties_summary: No specific monetary fines or statutory sanctions are set in this guidance; it directs authorities to severely crack down on verified illegal and non-compliant algorithm-related acts and calls for upcoming regulations to clarify legal liabilities.
implementation_notes: Joint ministerial Guiding Opinions (Guoxinban Fawen [2021] No. 7, dated 2021-09-17 and published online 2021-09-29) establishing a multi-dimensional algorithm regulatory framework—covering risk monitoring, security assessment, science and technology ethics review, graded and classified algorithm filing, and enforcement—while directing the drafting of binding algorithm management regulations and supporting standards and guidelines.
